_note: Forecast icing on an IFR route (#216), the engine's icing_forecast_route (engine/crates/brief/src/icing_forecast.rs): each leg's AWC icing cross-section, values level-fastest (values[level + column * data_levels]), 0 none, 1 trace, 2 light, 3 moderate, 4 heavy, negative none forecast; sfc_hgt the ground in metres. The answers are worked by hand from the rule: the levels either side of the altitude flown, the worse of them; a level under the ground is not read; any icing at the altitude, trace or worse, is the Go / No-Go's line (AIM 7-1-19). engine/facade/tests/icing_forecast.rs asks the engine each case; the planner asks the same name.

routes.about: Light icing on a third of leg 1 at 4,000 ft; moderate at 4,500 ft on leg 2, between two levels, read from the worse; leg 3 not had; leg 4's icing is under the ground

answer.line: Forecast icing, moderate, at 4,500 ft on leg 2

routes.about: Trace on two legs at two altitudes: still the line's, by AIM 7-1-19

answer.line: Forecast icing, trace, at 4,000 and 6,000 ft on legs 1 and 2

routes.about: Icing over the leg, none at the altitude flown; and a leg with no forecast at its altitude is unchecked
